text:
Meera (FinOps): Heads-up — generated March invoices for acct ACME-Corp show a mysterious $2,400 "Support" charge duplicated across two invoices (INV-2026-0312-88, INV-2026-0312-89). Also the reserved capacity discount (-$1,200) didn't apply on INV-2026-0312-89. Can someone from billing take a look?

Sam (Billing): yikes — can you drop the invoice JSON or PDF? I'll check generation logs :eyes:

Meera (FinOps): attaching snippets below (sanitized). CSV lines:
```
INV-2026-0312-88,Line,Description,Amount
INV-2026-0312-88,1,Hosted API usage,14200
INV-2026-0312-88,2,Support,2400
INV-2026-0312-88,3,Reserved capacity discount,-1200
```
```
INV-2026-0312-89,Line,Description,Amount
INV-2026-0312-89,1,Hosted API usage,26000
INV-2026-0312-89,2,Support,2400
```

Sam (Billing): I see the support line present on both. The discount missing on 89 — looks like the discount rule didn't fire. Pulling invoice generation logs... BillingBot: invoice-generation completed for batch=20260312 run_id=rg-92 status=partial_fail

BillingBot: anomaly detected: pricing_rule_apply_fails=1, duplicated_node=none

Olivia (CS): Customer called — they were billed twice for support on two invoices, pretty upset. ACME asked for credit and explanation.

Ajay (Pricing): I rolled a small pricing experiment yesterday that modifies how reserved discounts are joined to multi-account invoices. Could be related. @Sam — do you have the run_id? I'll search the ruleset evaluation for run rg-92.

Sam (Billing): run_id=rg-92 (above). Logs show pricing plugin threw a null pointer when matching reserved_discount if parent_account is null. Stack snippet:
```
error: pricing_plugin::apply_rule() -> NullPointerException at ReservDiscountMatcher.java:87
``` 

Nate (Revenue Ops): OK, action items: 1) issue immediate credit memo for INV-2026-0312-89 for $2400 2) re-run invoice generation for affected accounts with patched rule 3) prevent customer-facing communications until we confirm scope. @Meera can you approve the credit? :thumbsup:

Meera (FinOps): Approved for immediate $2400 credit to ACME-Corp. Please also hold any automated dunning emails.

Sam (Billing): Creating credit memo CM-2026-0312-01 now. Will re-run RG-92 in a sandbox after Ajay's patch. Draft note for CS: "We're issuing a credit for the duplicated support charge and will follow up once we complete a re-run and reconciliation." — @Olivia ok to send after credits posted?

Olivia (CS): That's fine. Please add a line that we will confirm there's no residual under/over billing by EOD PST.

Ajay (Pricing): pushed quick fix to pricing-rule repo (PR #421). It's a safe null-check. Scheduling a sandbox regen now.

BillingBot: credit-created id=CM-2026-0312-01 amount=2400 created_by=Sam status=pending

Sam (Billing): credit posted and applied to INV-2026-0312-89. Re-gen in progress (sandbox) — will post results shortly.

Sam (Billing): regen (sandbox) completed. Reserved discount now applied, no duplicate support line in sandbox. Will queue production regen after patch deploy window at 04:00 UTC.

Meera (FinOps): please also run an audit across March runs to find other invoices that may have missed reserved_discount. If more customers affected, we need an internal incident.

Nate (Revenue Ops): I'll run a quick query: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoices WHERE period='2026-03' AND reserved_discount_applied=false; back in 10.

BillingBot: scheduled job invoice-audit-20260312 started

Sam (Billing): thanks all — I'll post a short postmortem draft once prod regen completes and we confirm scope.

Olivia (CS): thx. I'll hold ACME comms until you confirm.

(Meera pinned)
